# Vendored EasyTHS

Upstream: https://github.com/noimank/easyths  
License: MIT  
Purpose: Tonghuashun (`xiadan.exe`) GUI automation via local REST (`:7648`).

Integration in this repo:
- Bridge: `tools/easyths_bridge/worker.py`
- Start server: `scripts/start_easyths.ps1`
- Start bridge: `scripts/start_easyths_bridge.ps1`
- Desk channel: `broker_channel = "mouse_sim"` in settings
